title: Add expected typ verification to JWT
prompt: Add support for verifying the JOSE typ header in Hono's JWT utilities and middleware. Extend VerifyOptions with an optional typ field that accepts a string or an array of strings. When it is set, verify and verifyWithJwks must reject a token whose typ does not match; comparison must treat typ as a case-insensitive media type and allow the application/ prefix to be omitted. When it is unset, preserve current behavior by accepting a case-insensitive JWT or a token with no typ. A JWT middleware verification option must pass the setting through. Add focused tests in src/utils/jwt/jwt.test.ts and src/middleware/jwt/index.test.ts, then run the JWT utility and middleware suites.
acceptance: VerifyOptions accepts typ as a string or string array
A token with a mismatched typ is rejected with JwtHeaderInvalid
typ matching is case-insensitive and ignores an application/ prefix
Both JWT suites pass and cover the new behavior
verification: pnpm exec vp test --run src/utils/jwt/jwt.test.ts && pnpm exec vp test --run src/middleware/jwt/index.test.ts && grep -q "typ: 'at+jwt'" src/utils/jwt/jwt.test.ts && grep -q "typ: 'at+jwt'" src/middleware/jwt/index.test.ts
